front: Normal peak velocity across the LVOT?
Normal peak velocity in the ascending aorta?
Normal peak mitral E velocity in a young adult?
back: ~1.0 m/s (range 0.6 – 1.3 m/s). Mitral A is 0.2 – 0.7 m/s, giving E/A > 1.

front: How does the mitral E/A ratio typically change with age?
back: Young: E/A > 1. Around age 50–60: ≈ 1. Older: E/A < 1 (impaired relaxation is the norm). E velocity falls, DT prolongs, A velocity rises.

front: What are the three components of a normal pulmonary vein PW Doppler signal?
back: S wave (systolic forward flow), D wave (diastolic forward flow), and A-reversal (atrial contraction-induced retrograde flow into the PV).

front: Where do you place the PW sample volume to measure mitral inflow?
back: At the tips of the mitral leaflets during maximum leaflet opening (early diastole).

front: Which Doppler modality is used to measure e′ at the mitral annulus?
back: Tissue Doppler (PW-TDI) with the sample volume at the septal and lateral mitral annulus.
